text:
Anya: Heads-up — bulk import left several rules with identical priority. The list just stacks them with no hint, which confused a PM. Idea: add a small inline "Conflict" pill that shows count and a keyboard-first Resolve flow. Josie: +1. Pill should be role=button, tabbable, announce via aria-live when it appears. Example aria snippet I can add:
Priority conflict detected between "Promo - CA" and "Promo - US"
. Marco: From preview side, if a user resolves a conflict we should only re-run the sandbox for the affected route. We can accept a route-delta and apply an incremental sim instead of full recalculation. Priya: UX copy: pill reads "Conflict (2)"; modal title "Resolve priority conflict"; primary actions Promote / Demote; secondary Merge behind a More menu with confirmation. Merge tooltip: "Combine selectors and join rule bodies." Anya: Keep modal light: trap focus while open, Esc to close, return focus to pill on dismiss. Make the diff compact (conditions left, actions right) and show a tiny preview of match order. Josie: For cascading conflicts (A vs B, B vs C) show chips on each affected rule and let the modal navigate related conflicts. Also add pluralization tests for screen reader phrasing. design-bot: Uploaded mock: https://redwood.design/mockups/1745678901-resolve-pill.png — shows pill, modal, and incremental-sim badge. Marco: Dev checklist: 1) aria-live announce 2) render pill (button) 3) keyboard modal w/diffs 4) PATCH /routes/:id/resolve-conflict {action:..., target_priority:?} -> returns route delta 5) apply incremental sim for route 6) hide Merge behind confirmation 7) unit tests for focus + keyboard. Priya: Also add a toast on import: "Priority conflicts detected in Route: Checkout — Review" that focuses the first pill on click. Toast should land in the toast tray. Anya: Action items: Josie add a11y snippets & copy, Marco spec incremental sim API, Priya & I will prototype the pill/modal and bring to next UX sync. Thanks! :raised_hands:
